comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body: Evaluated epic 3006-e198 (level-triggered bridge convergence) before implementation. Findings: (1) implementation is greenfield — no classify(), no per-binding baseline; ADRs 0026-0029 committed on feat/bridge-convergence (rebased onto origin/main cleanly). (2) No genesis session_log exists in the store; audit evidence lives in the epic + 4 child bugs (high quality: runtime proofs + commit archaeology). (3) Web research (authorized) validates the design against OSS peers: level-triggered = k8s doctrine; per-binding baseline = kubectl last-applied / Terraform state; circuit breaker = Entra Connect deletion threshold + GCDS delete limits + Argo allowEmpty; Exalate per-pair replica = same baseline pattern; convergence-as-tested-property is ahead of common controller practice. (4) Risk verdict: MEDIUM overall — no hard deletes anywhere, bindings.json committed per pass, workflow mode input = one-click brake; ONE high-risk seam = prev_snapshot -> per-binding baseline swap (silent teammate-edit clobber). (5) Derisk ladder E1-E5 (offline replay go/no-go, property suite, baseline dual-write shadow, CI shadow consumer, capped rollout) + 5 peer-pattern gaps (observedGeneration, backoff-before-quarantine, finalizers, resync knob, optimistic write precondition) recorded as a comment on the epic.

comments.body: Derisk experiments EXECUTED for epic 3006-e198 (all offline, zero Jira writes, production artifacts): X1 inputs healthy (614/614 confirmed bindings; bindings-retired.json has never existed — corroborates class C); X2 drift census = EXACTLY the 7 known instances, zero unknown (A: REB-464/456/465/466/457 all To Do; B: REB-532; C: f8b5->REB-530; D: bridge-fsck reports clean over this store); X3 classifier spike: acting 7/615 = 1.14% (8.8x breaker headroom), acting set == known drift exactly, simulated heal reaches fixed point in one pass; X4 baselines 100% seedable from prev_snapshot (all 5 fields on all 613 bound+present keys). Epic ACs amended with: decision-census telemetry, baseline dual-write shadow, frozen-artifact census replay test. Emergent bug filed + linked discovered_from: rebar list --status=<invalid> silently returns [].

comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body: Epic 3006-e198 restructured for implementation-by-less-capable-agent (remediations 1-3 approved). Created 2 foundation children: amiss-bun-wince/baf7 (pure classify() + Decision matrix spec with anchor cells, per-binding baseline schema + seed, census + breaker, 5 named test files incl. frozen-census replay and multi-pass fault-injection) and soar-quill-flare/7d23 (4-phase rollout: dual-write shadow >=10 clean passes -> census/divergence alerting -> consumer swap w/ direction-preservation RED test -> capped live heal of the 7 instances; rollback = workflow mode input). Appended '## Implementation contract' sections to all 4 drift bugs (each names its Decision cells, exact helper functions to reuse vs not reimplement, RED tests, live acceptance cells, ADR prerequisites). Wired deps: 4 bugs depends_on baf7; 7d23 depends_on all 4 bugs — next-batch now yields exactly baf7. Set file-impact + verify-commands on all 6 children. Epic AC updated to name the 6-child execution order. All 7 tickets pass clarity/check-ac/quality gates; store validate clean for this epic.
